problem.statement: PCB component shift detected in final inspection: resistor R42 (10k) positioned 0.8 mm off-center on pad, causing open circuit in biasing network.
problem.observed_effect: Biasing network open circuit; downstream analog circuit fails self-test during power-on.
problem.impact: Yield loss: 2.3% of production lot (115 units); customer warranty risk.

why_tree.question: Why did the resistor shift during assembly?
why_tree.answer: Pick-and-place nozzle pressure was set too high, causing lateral acceleration when nozzle released component.

why_tree.question: Why was nozzle pressure set incorrectly?
why_tree.answer: Machine parameter settings were not updated when component supplier changed from 0603 metric to 0603 imperial (slightly different dimensions and mass).

why_tree.question: Why were settings not updated for new supplier?
why_tree.answer: No procedure existed to validate machine settings during supplier changeover; ECN process did not include manufacturing engineering review.

why_tree.question: Why was there no manufacturing review step?
why_tree.answer: ECN process template was last updated 3 years ago; no one realized component sourcing changes required machine parameter validation.

why_tree.question: Root cause: Why has the ECN process not been updated?
why_tree.answer: Process documentation ownership was unclear after recent organizational restructuring; no quarterly review was scheduled.

root_causes.cause: ECN process lacks manufacturing engineering review step for component sourcing changes.
root_causes.evidence: Reviewed 5 prior ECNs: supplier changes approved by procurement/quality without manufacturing validation. No machine parameter impact assessment documented.
root_causes.contributing_factors: Process owner unclear after reorganization; no scheduled quarterly review; component mass/dimension differences not flagged as design-critical.

root_causes.cause: No automated supplier component datasheet comparison tool; dimensional and mass data manually compared (missed 0.15 mm difference).
root_causes.evidence: Manual spreadsheet review process; no delta-check step; tolerance stack-up analysis not triggered until assembly issue appeared.
root_causes.contributing_factors: Datasheet management tool not yet deployed; IT resources redirected to other projects.

corrective_actions.action: Add Manufacturing Engineering sign-off step to ECN process for all component sourcing changes (new supplier, new part number, dimension/mass changes). Require machine parameter impact assessment.
corrective_actions.verification_method: Audit 10 future ECNs; confirm manufacturing review completed and documented.

corrective_actions.action: Implement automated component datasheet comparison tool (use supplier PDM API); alert on any dimension/mass delta >0.05 mm or >5 mg.
corrective_actions.verification_method: Tool deployed; test case: detect 0.15 mm difference in historical changeover.

corrective_actions.action: Assign clear process owner for ECN document; establish quarterly review cycle (next review: 2026-06-01).
corrective_actions.verification_method: Process owner name and review schedule documented in management system.

verification.metric: % of component sourcing ECNs with manufacturing review documented
Process owner assigned and review scheduled
